scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm -w @cineweave/web run dev" "npm -w @cineweave/api run dev" "npm -w @cineweave/worker run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm -w @cineweave/api run build && npm -w @cineweave/worker run build && npm -w @cineweave/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm -w @cineweave/api run typecheck && npm -w @cineweave/worker run typecheck && npm -w @cineweave/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm -w @cineweave/graph-runtime run test
scripts.build:packages: npm -w @cineweave/contracts run build && npm -w @cineweave/graph-runtime run build
